description: Individual incremental balancing energy bids (Historical data as of 22/05/2024) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Individual incremental energy bid volumes and prices for automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve (aFRR) and manual Frequency Restoration Reserve (mFRR) both day-ahead and intraday - submitted by Balance responsible Parties (BRPs) and Balance Service Providers (BSPs), taking into account the known technical and contractual constraints. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Market, Bidding. The portal shows 2026-06-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
